title: New Evening Classes at the Community Centre
instructions: 这是一份原创的成人英语听力与语法练习材料（模拟材料，非官方雅思考试）。请先听/读对话，完成8道听力理解题；然后学习现在完成时入门规则，完成8道语法题；最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。所有题目选项均为英文，解释为中文。
transcript:
Maya: Hi Tom. You look happy today.
Tom: Yes! I started a new evening class at the community centre. It's a computer class.
Maya: Really? When did you start?
Tom: I started last Monday. I have already finished two lessons.
Maya: Wow, that's fast. Have you done any homework yet?
Tom: No, I haven't done any homework yet. The teacher gives us homework on Friday.
Maya: How long is the course?
Tom: It's for ten weeks. I have been in the class since last Monday.
Maya: Is it expensive?
Tom: No, it's free for adults over eighteen. The centre has offered free classes for three years.
Maya: That's great. I have wanted to learn computers for a long time.
Tom: You should join! The next class is on Wednesday. Have you ever used a computer before?
Maya: Yes, I have used one at work, but only for email. I haven't used other programs yet.
Tom: That's fine. The teacher is very patient. She has taught here since 2019.
Maya: Has she given you a book?
Tom: Yes, she has already given us a small book. It's easy to read.
Maya: Good. I will call the centre tomorrow. I have not called them yet.
Tom: Do it soon. The class is small. Only twelve people have joined so far.
Maya: OK. Thanks, Tom. See you on Wednesday!
Tom: See you!

grammar.title: 现在完成时入门：already / yet / since / for 与一般过去时的区别
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时表示“到现在为止已经发生的事”或“从过去持续到现在的状态”。结构是 have/has + 过去分词。already 用于肯定句，表示“已经”；yet 用于否定句和疑问句，表示“还/已经”；since 后接时间点（如 since 2019），for 后接时间段（如 for three years）。一般过去时只说明过去某个时间发生的事，不强调与现在的联系，常与 last Monday 等具体过去时间连用。例如：I started last Monday.（一般过去时） vs. I have been in the class since last Monday.（现在完成时，持续到现在）。
grammar.example: I have been in the class since last Monday.

questions.prompt: I ______ my homework. I can watch TV now.
questions.explanation: 表示“已经完成”，对现在有影响（可以看电视），用现在完成时 have finished。
有明确过去时间 last year，用一般过去时 went。
questions.evidence: She went to London last year.

questions.explanation: 现在完成时疑问句 Have you + 过去分词，eat 的过去分词是 eaten。
questions.evidence: Have you eaten your lunch yet?

questions.prompt: They have worked in this office ______ five years.
questions.explanation: five years 是时间段，用 for。
questions.evidence: They have worked in this office for five years.

questions.prompt: He ______ his keys. He can't open the door.
questions.explanation: 表示过去发生的事对现在造成影响（打不开门），用现在完成时 has lost。
yesterday 是明确过去时间，用一般过去时 visited。
否定句中表示“还”，用 yet。
